extraction.method: Single native containing 30-arcsecond pixel at the reported orchard coordinate; no overview, interpolation, nearest-coast fill or score sampling
extraction.missing: Explicit null with source_nodata/outside_source_extent reason, without spatial substitution
extraction.precisionCaveat: Published minute-rounded orchard coordinates are approximate; native raster sampling does not improve orchard coordinate precision.

fieldInterpretation.bio18: Three-month precipitation total, mm. Verified against independent sums of monthly CHELSA pr and tas at 16 controls; source long_name says monthly mean, but numeric values match quarter totals.
fieldInterpretation.bio19: Three-month precipitation total, mm; source long_name says monthly mean. Raw data retained without multiplying by three.
fieldInterpretation.bio06: Mean daily minimum of the coldest month; NOT an absolute winter minimum.
fieldInterpretation.hursmean: Mean annual near-surface relative humidity; NOT summer-specific humidity.
fieldInterpretation.fcf: Annual freeze–thaw transition count; NOT number of frost days.
